purpose: This table provides one cleaned, deduplicated record per airport sourced from the OurAirports bronze feed, carrying identifiers, codes, geolocation, administrative placement, and reference links for downstream geospatial and reference joins.
usage: Join on id as the declared grain key; treat icao_code, gps_code, local_code, home_link, wikipedia_link, and keywords as optionally present and filter or coalesce as needed since each carries a nonzero null rate; has_scheduled_service is a boolean derived from the original yes/no text flag.
limitations: No bronze duplicate rows were found (duplicate_row_rate 0.0) so no dedupe logic was applied; local_code (63.7% null), home_link (74.9% null), and keywords (68.0% null) remain sparsely populated and were not imputed or dropped, so consumers must handle missingness explicitly.
